dogecoin.text: @DorianKafka Hey, there! All stores can accept Cryptocurrency by enabling an alternative payment gateway in their checkout (https://t.co/SCjYRF9t7b). As long as the gateway deals with Dogecoin, then that merchant can accept it as payment for their goods. Hope that helps! -Helen
@TenshiUchiha2 Hi! To clarify, are you wondering if you'll be able to pay the Shopify monthly subscription with Dogecoin? -Peter

@DuendeSaudade For example, in the United States, CoinPayments is a third-party gateway that integrates with Shopify and enables you to accept Dogecoin: (https://t.co/HfOuJPwXPP). If you have any further questions for our team, feel free to let us know! (2/2) - Finley

@DuendeSaudade Hey, there! Are you referring to having Dogecoin as a payment method on your website for your customers? If so, you can see if one of our approved payment providers offers Dogecoin as an option: (https://t.co/bkuGygZIaW). (1/2)

@iamszaee Hey, there! You'll need to check the approved third-party payment gateways available in your country here: (https://t.co/bkuGygZIaW). For example, in the United States, CoinPayments is a payment provider that enables you to accept Dogecoin. I hope that helps! - Finley

@BlackDujon Hey, there. While dogecoin is currently not supported, we do; however; support other crypocurrencies (https://t.co/egVFD4pxyM). If you have any other questions, don't hesitate to let us know! -Elias
